roadmap.title: Story arcs and mission percentage
roadmap.description: Play the five story arcs and replay missions with all bonus conditions to reach 50% mission completion.

roadmap.title: Village tasks
roadmap.description: Do the rope, Rasengan door, shuriken, Naruto cannon, order list, handbook, support book and ramen tasks in the Leaf Village.

roadmap.title: General Store purchases
roadmap.description: Spend Ryo on figures, Ultimate Jutsu movies and music tracks.

roadmap.title: Finisher and combat events
roadmap.description: Earn the finisher and combat-event achievements; if they do not unlock against the computer, repeat them in a 2P Free Battle with a second controller.

roadmap.title: Final unlock
roadmap.description: Perfect Storm Master unlocks once every other achievement is done.

achievements.description: Unlocked all the achievements.
achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement.

steps.text: Finish every other achievement on the list; this one unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Completed the Genin Training Arc.
achievements.summary: Complete all 7 missions of the @loc{Genin Training Arc}.

steps.text: Play the story missions in order until the seventh mission of the arc is done.

achievements.description: Completed the Chunin Exam Arc.
achievements.summary: Complete all 11 missions of the @loc{Chunin Exam Arc}.

steps.text: Play the story missions in order until the eleventh mission of the arc is done.

achievements.description: Completed the Leaf Destruction Arc.
achievements.summary: Complete all 10 missions of the @loc{Leaf Destruction Arc}.

steps.text: Play the story missions in order until the tenth mission of the arc is done.

achievements.displayName: The Search for Tsunade Arc Complete
achievements.description: Completed the Tsunade Search Arc.
achievements.summary: Complete all 11 missions of the @loc{Search for Tsunade Arc}.

steps.text: Play the story missions in order until the eleventh mission of the arc is done.

achievements.description: Completed the Chasing Sasuke Arc.
achievements.summary: Complete all 10 missions of the @loc{Chasing Sasuke Arc}.

steps.text: Play the story missions in order until the tenth mission of the arc is done.

achievements.description: Completed over 10% of the missions.
achievements.summary: Reach 10% total mission completion.

guide.context: Story missions and ranked freeplay missions both count. Replaying a mission and meeting its bonus conditions also raises the percentage.

steps.text: Complete missions until the mission percentage reaches 10%.

achievements.description: Completed over 20% of the missions.
achievements.summary: Reach 20% total mission completion.

guide.context: Story missions and ranked freeplay missions both count. Replaying a mission and meeting its bonus conditions also raises the percentage.

steps.text: Complete missions until the mission percentage reaches 20%.

achievements.description: Completed over 30% of the missions.
achievements.summary: Reach 30% total mission completion.

guide.context: Story missions and ranked freeplay missions both count. Replaying a mission and meeting its bonus conditions also raises the percentage.

steps.text: Complete missions until the mission percentage reaches 30%.

achievements.description: Completed over 40% of the missions.
achievements.summary: Reach 40% total mission completion.

guide.context: Story missions and ranked freeplay missions both count. Replaying a mission and meeting its bonus conditions also raises the percentage.

steps.text: Complete missions until the mission percentage reaches 40%.

achievements.description: Completed over 50% of the missions.
achievements.summary: Reach 50% total mission completion.

guide.context: Freeplay missions unlock as the story advances. There is no achievement for 100%.

steps.text: Finish the story missions.
Clear the D, C and B rank freeplay missions, meeting every bonus condition, until the percentage reaches 50%.

achievements.description: A new item was added to the shop.
achievements.summary: Finish one order list at the item shop.

steps.text: Collect the ingredients an order list asks for by fighting and exploring.
Open the order list at the bottom of the @loc{item shop} menu in the western part of the village and finish one.
Open the buy menu; it reports new stock and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Six or more different items were added to the shop.
achievements.summary: Finish six order lists at the item shop.

steps.text: Finish six order lists in total at the bottom of the @loc{item shop} menu, collecting ingredients from fights and exploring.
Open the buy menu after the last list so the new stock is reported.

achievements.description: Acquired a Support Ninjutsu Book.
achievements.summary: Buy one Support Ninjutsu Book.

guide.context: Buy your support books before you finish the story, because @npc{Iruka} may stop selling them afterward.

steps.text: Collect secret scrolls, which drop right after finishing missions.
Buy a support book from @npc{Iruka}, just west of the Hokage's office, then leave the store menu.

achievements.description: Acquired eight or more Support Ninjutsu Books.
achievements.summary: Buy 8 Support Ninjutsu Books.

guide.context: About 8,000 to 10,000 Ryo covers every support book. Buy them before you finish the story, because @npc{Iruka} may stop selling them afterward.

steps.text: Collect enough secret scrolls from finished missions.
Buy 8 support books from @npc{Iruka}, just west of the Hokage's office, and leave the store menu.

achievements.description: Acquired a Ninja Handbook.
achievements.summary: Obtain one Ninja Handbook.

steps.text: Progress through the story, then walk to a green dot on the village map to pick up a handbook.

achievements.description: Acquired 14 or more Ninja Handbooks.
achievements.summary: Obtain 14 Ninja Handbooks.

steps.text: Pick up handbooks at the green dots that appear on the village map as the story advances.
Continue until you have 14; they are normally all available by the last arc.

achievements.description: Created a new Ichiraku Ramen.
achievements.summary: Make one new ramen at @loc{Ichiraku}.

steps.text: Get the ingredients a first ramen order asks for; these drop from fights.
Go to @loc{Ichiraku} and make the ramen.

achievements.description: Created 10 or more different Ichiraku Ramens.
achievements.summary: Make 10 different ramens at @loc{Ichiraku}.

steps.text: Progress through the story so the one-time village ingredients appear, and collect battle drops such as flowers.
Go to @loc{Ichiraku} and make 10 different ramens.

achievements.description: Acquired a Figure.
achievements.summary: Buy one figure.

guide.context: Buy these at the @loc{General Store}, marked with a red ring on the map. Items unlock as the story advances. All the shop purchases together cost about 655,000 Ryo, so do them after the story or some freeplay missions.

steps.text: Buy any figure at the @loc{General Store}; the cheapest costs 5,000 Ryo.

achievements.description: Acquired over 30% of all Figures.
achievements.summary: Own at least 30% of the figures, which is 16 of 53.

guide.context: Buy these at the @loc{General Store}, marked with a red ring on the map. Items unlock as the story advances. All the shop purchases together cost about 655,000 Ryo, so do them after the story or some freeplay missions.

steps.text: Buy figures until you own 16; the cheapest are 5,000 Ryo each, so at least 80,000 Ryo in total.

achievements.description: Acquired over 50% of all Figures.
achievements.summary: Own at least 50% of the figures, which is 27 of 53.

guide.context: Buy these at the @loc{General Store}, marked with a red ring on the map. Items unlock as the story advances. All the shop purchases together cost about 655,000 Ryo, so do them after the story or some freeplay missions.

steps.text: Buy figures until you own 27; at the cheapest price this costs at least 135,000 Ryo in total.

achievements.description: Acquired an Ultimate Jutsu Movie.
achievements.summary: Buy one Ultimate Jutsu movie.

guide.context: Buy these at the @loc{General Store}, marked with a red ring on the map. Items unlock as the story advances. All the shop purchases together cost about 655,000 Ryo, so do them after the story or some freeplay missions.

steps.text: Buy any Ultimate Jutsu movie at the @loc{General Store}; the cheapest costs 25,000 Ryo.

achievements.description: Acquired over 30% of all Ultimate Jutsu Movies.
achievements.summary: Own at least 30% of the Ultimate Jutsu movies, which is 11 of 35.

guide.context: Buy these at the @loc{General Store}, marked with a red ring on the map. Items unlock as the story advances. All the shop purchases together cost about 655,000 Ryo, so do them after the story or some freeplay missions.

steps.text: Buy movies until you own 11; at the cheapest price this costs at least 275,000 Ryo in total.

achievements.description: Acquired over 50% of all Ultimate Jutsu Movies.
achievements.summary: Own at least 50% of the Ultimate Jutsu movies, which is 18 of 35.

guide.context: Buy these at the @loc{General Store}, marked with a red ring on the map. Items unlock as the story advances. All the shop purchases together cost about 655,000 Ryo, so do them after the story or some freeplay missions.

steps.text: Buy movies until you own 18; at the cheapest price this costs at least 450,000 Ryo in total.

achievements.description: Acquired a music file.
achievements.summary: Buy one music track.

guide.context: Buy these at the @loc{General Store}, marked with a red ring on the map. Items unlock as the story advances. All the shop purchases together cost about 655,000 Ryo, so do them after the story or some freeplay missions.

steps.text: Buy any music track at the @loc{General Store}; the cheapest costs 5,000 Ryo.

achievements.description: Acquired over 30% of all music files.
achievements.summary: Own at least 30% of the music tracks, which is 9 of 28.

guide.context: Buy these at the @loc{General Store}, marked with a red ring on the map. Items unlock as the story advances. All the shop purchases together cost about 655,000 Ryo, so do them after the story or some freeplay missions.

steps.text: Buy tracks until you own 9; at the cheapest price this costs at least 45,000 Ryo in total.

achievements.description: Acquired over 50% of all music files.
achievements.summary: Own at least 50% of the music tracks, which is 14 of 28.

guide.context: Buy these at the @loc{General Store}, marked with a red ring on the map. Items unlock as the story advances. All the shop purchases together cost about 655,000 Ryo, so do them after the story or some freeplay missions.

steps.text: Buy tracks until you own 14; at the cheapest price this costs at least 70,000 Ryo in total.

achievements.description: Performed six or more successful rope actions.
achievements.summary: Make 6 successful rope actions in the village.

steps.text: Land on a rope in the village, then press the jump prompt each time you leave it.
Chain 6 successful rope swings without stopping on a rope.

achievements.description: Destroyed a door with a Rasengan.
achievements.summary: Break a sealed door with a Rasengan.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Search for Tsunade Arc} so Rasengan is available in the village.
Find a sealed door, activate it and mash the quick-time prompt until the door breaks.

achievements.description: Destroyed five or more objects with one shuriken toss.
achievements.summary: Destroy 5 objects with one shuriken throw.

guide.context: Each pouch raises how many targets you can lock onto; one pouch allows five.

steps.text: Buy a shuriken pouch at the @loc{item shop} in the western part of the village.
Enter shuriken mode, lock onto five objects and throw.

achievements.description: Destroyed 10 or more objects with one shuriken toss.
achievements.summary: Destroy 10 objects with one shuriken throw.

steps.text: Buy all six shuriken pouches at the @loc{item shop} in the western part of the village.
Enter shuriken mode, lock onto ten objects and throw.

achievements.description: Cleared 12 or more rings with one Naruto Cannon.
achievements.summary: Clear 12 rings with one Naruto Cannon.

guide.context: All three cannon achievements can be earned in one run through the line of 42 rings.

steps.text: Clear all of @npc{Kakashi}'s ring challenges to unlock the A-rank mission @loc{Jiraiya's Special Training}.
Start the mission and head due south-east to the straight line of 42 obstacle rings.
Fly through rings with one cannon until you pass 12.

achievements.description: Cleared 24 or more rings with one Naruto Cannon.
achievements.summary: Clear 24 rings with one Naruto Cannon.

guide.context: All three cannon achievements can be earned in one run through the line of 42 rings.

steps.text: Clear all of @npc{Kakashi}'s ring challenges to unlock the A-rank mission @loc{Jiraiya's Special Training}.
Start the mission and head due south-east to the straight line of 42 obstacle rings.
Fly through rings with one cannon until you pass 24.

achievements.description: Cleared 42 or more rings with one Naruto Cannon.
achievements.summary: Clear 42 rings with one Naruto Cannon.

guide.context: All three cannon achievements can be earned in one run through the line of 42 rings. Hitting a ring obstacle stops the cannon, so a miss means resetting and running back.

steps.text: Clear all of @npc{Kakashi}'s ring challenges to unlock the A-rank mission @loc{Jiraiya's Special Training}.
Start the mission and head due south-east to the straight line of 42 obstacle rings.
Fly through all 42 rings in one cannon.

achievements.description: Finished an opponent with an item.
achievements.summary: Defeat an opponent with a ninja tool as the final blow.

guide.context: This unlock often fails against the computer. If it does not unlock, repeat it in a 2P @mechanic{Free Battle} with a second controller and have the second player stand still.

steps.text: Use a character with combat tools, such as explosive balls or the parachute kunai.
Bring the opponent to very low health, then finish with the tool.

achievements.description: Finished an opponent with a Support Combo.
achievements.summary: Defeat an opponent with a support character's Combo as the final blow.

guide.context: A support combo can also come from a combo that launches the foe at an angle: a shoulder-button prompt appears, and your support then strikes. The support hit must finish the fight. This unlock often fails against the computer. If it does not unlock, repeat it in a 2P @mechanic{Free Battle} with a second controller and have the second player stand still.

steps.text: Pick a support character and set their move to @mechanic{Combo}, the first move in their list, instead of a ninjutsu.
Bring the opponent to very low health and call the support so their combo lands the final hit.

achievements.description: Finished an opponent with Support Ninjutsu.
achievements.summary: Defeat an opponent with a support character's ninjutsu as the final blow.

guide.context: Any support character and move works; Sasuke's fireball is a good one. This unlock often fails against the computer. If it does not unlock, repeat it in a 2P @mechanic{Free Battle} with a second controller and have the second player stand still.

steps.text: Bring the opponent to very low health.
Call a support character and let their ninjutsu land the final hit.

achievements.description: Finished an opponent with an Ultimate Jutsu.
achievements.summary: Defeat an opponent with an Ultimate Jutsu as the final blow.

steps.text: Use your character's Ultimate Jutsu when the opponent is low enough that it ends the fight.

achievements.displayName: Finish with a Full Power Ultimate Jutsu!
achievements.description: Finished an opponent with an Ultimate Jutsu with the Storm Gauge at MAX.
achievements.summary: Defeat an opponent with an Ultimate Jutsu while the Storm Gauge is at MAX.

guide.context: An Ultimate Jutsu that leaves the opponent alive wastes the attempt, so begin a fresh fight.

steps.text: Keep comboing until all three tomoe of the Storm Gauge, left of the health and chakra bars, turn to flames.
While Full Power lasts, land an Ultimate Jutsu that ends the fight.

achievements.description: Finished an opponent with an Ultimate Impact.
achievements.summary: Defeat an opponent with an Ultimate Impact as the final blow.

guide.context: This unlock often fails against the computer. If it does not unlock, repeat it in a 2P @mechanic{Free Battle} with a second controller and have the second player stand still.

steps.text: Hold the attack button to charge an Ultimate Impact.
Land it as the final hit.

achievements.description: Finished an opponent with a throw.
achievements.summary: Defeat an opponent with a throw as the final blow.

guide.context: This unlock often fails against the computer. If it does not unlock, repeat it in a 2P @mechanic{Free Battle} with a second controller and have the second player stand still.

steps.text: Bring the opponent to low health.
Attack while guarding to throw them; the throw has very short range.

achievements.description: Finished an opponent with Ninjutsu.
achievements.summary: Defeat an opponent with a ninjutsu attack as the final blow.

steps.text: Use your character's ninjutsu when the opponent is low enough that it ends the fight.

achievements.description: Finished an opponent with an additional strike after downing them.
achievements.summary: Defeat an opponent with a downed strike as the final blow.

guide.context: The downed strike is the weak hit from pressing attack next to a downed opponent, and it must land the final blow. The computer often blocks this unlock, so have the second player stand still.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{Free Battle} with a second controller, set the handicap fully in your favor and pick @npc{Naruto}.
Hit once with a basic attack, then throw the opponent and hit them on the ground with a single extra strike.
Keep throwing until they are almost out of health, then finish with the downed strike.

achievements.description: Finished an opponent while Awakened.
achievements.summary: Defeat an opponent while in Awakened mode.

steps.text: Take enough damage that a fire symbol appears at the end of your chakra gauge.
Keep charging chakra to enter Awakened mode, then win the fight with any attack.

achievements.description: Interrupted an opponent's Ultimate Jutsu.
achievements.summary: Interrupt an opponent's Ultimate Jutsu.

guide.context: This unlock often fails against the computer. If it does not unlock, repeat it in a 2P @mechanic{Free Battle} with a second controller and have the second player stand still.

steps.text: Let the opponent target and hit you with an Ultimate Jutsu.
Win the button-press showdown so you evade or substitute out partway through the animation.

achievements.displayName: Succeed with a Supportive Extra Hit!
achievements.description: Attacked an opponent with a Supportive Extra Hit.
achievements.summary: Hit an opponent with a Supportive Extra Hit.

guide.context: This unlock often fails against the computer. If it does not unlock, repeat it in a 2P @mechanic{Free Battle} with a second controller and have the second player stand still.

steps.text: Blow the opponent away with a hit.
Press the support button when the prompt flashes so your support strikes them.

achievements.description: Prevented an opponent's Extra Hit.
achievements.summary: Prevent an opponent's Extra Hit.

guide.context: In a 2P fight, launch the other player into the air and have them press the support button. This unlock often fails against the computer. If it does not unlock, repeat it in a 2P @mechanic{Free Battle} with a second controller and have the second player stand still.

steps.text: Get blown away by the opponent.
Press the support button when the prompt flashes so your support saves you.

achievements.displayName: This is how a ninja fights!
achievements.description: Finished off an opponent from a wall.
achievements.summary: Defeat an opponent while you are standing on a wall.

guide.context: Another heavy attack pushes you both off the wall, and an Ultimate Jutsu finish did not count. A throw near a wall followed by basic attacks also works. This unlock often fails against the computer. If it does not unlock, repeat it in a 2P @mechanic{Free Battle} with a second controller and have the second player stand still.

steps.text: Blow the opponent into a wall with a heavy attack, such as an Ultimate Impact, so you both stick to it.
Finish them with basic attacks while on the wall.

achievements.description: Won a Jutsu Clash.
achievements.summary: Win a Jutsu Clash.

guide.context: A clash starts when both fighters use ninjutsu at the same moment. The computer often blocks this unlock; if it does not unlock, repeat it in a 2P @mechanic{Free Battle} with a second controller. Both players press Y and B together and hold B, then player one mashes. The second player should not otherwise act.

steps.text: In the final story mission against @npc{Sasuke}, wait for him to charge Chidori.
Quickly use Rasengan so the two attacks meet, then mash the prompted button to win the clash.
